text:
mina_ml: quick flag  found a reproducible token-boundary failure during ari-compact int8 bring-up. zh->en BLEU on sinic-mini dropped -2.1 vs fp16. example below.

li_zhang: paste config + example please

mina_ml: repro run id 2026-03-23-ari-int8-boundary. model ari-compact-v2, quant=int8 (per-channel), clip=kl-symmetric, kernels=auto. tokenizer build v2026-02-25. evalset: sinic-mini (1.2k pairs). sample: 
```
input: "台港話 比 台語 更 豐富。"
fp16: "Hong Kong speech is richer than Taiwanese Mandarin."
int8: "HongKongspeech is richer than Taiwanese Mandarin."
// note: missing spaces after localized tokens -> fused subtokens
```

sam_qc: that looks like a detokenization / frontier collapse, not a straight semantic swap. did you run tokenizer.roundtrip? any norm diffs?

mina_ml: yes roundtrip ok. token ids match pre/post. issue appears only at inference output, not during tokenization. reproduced on cpu/gpu shards. suspect numeric drift in KV pathway or attention kernel for short-prefix sequences (1-3 subtokens).

ken_ops: did you try forcing FP16 for KV cache? we had similar symptoms in other quant bringups when using int8 kernels for KV.

mina_ml: ran with --force-fp16-kv on same shard. BLEU improved to -0.4 delta and sample detokenized correctly. p50 latency +11ms.

li_zhang: good signal. can you dump kv tensors + attention masks for failing sample (both int8 and fp16-kv) and attach to issue? i'll look at kernel selection heuristics.

mina_ml: attached tarball to IR (https://redwood.internal/issue/ARI-INT8-512). also added a tiny fuzz test that injects ambiguous grapheme runs to catch future regressions.

eva_research: follow-up: try low-noise quant config (reduce per-channel scale granularity) and also run int8 with RT_ACCUM_FP16=true (accumulate in fp16) to see if accumulation error explains alignment shift.

ken_ops: for early Dedicated customers we should add a safety gate in the optimizer: when locale tag in dataset includes zh/ja/kr, recommend KV_FP16 until kernel validated. I'll add a temporary opt-out flag to quant-recommendations.

ci-bot: triggered full CI: eng-ml/ari-compact-int8 #3019 (builders 4). logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/3019

sam_qc: also saw a handful of similar detok glitches on ja vertical punctuation in the same run. collecting threads to see if it's the same root cause.

mina_ml: thanks all. i'll follow up in the issue with kv dumps and the fuzz harness PR. keeping int8 canary paused until kernel triage. :thumbsup:
